recommendation_summary: The reply recommends keeping nightly-sync on edna and adding a dead-man switch: a self-hosted Healthchecks container on the Synology that the script pings, which emails the user if no success ping arrives by 04:30.

labels.Requirements and who asked: failure alert with no log reading (you, required); central log on Synology plus everything in Docker (you, suggested)
labels.Deleted: central log and Docker migration, neither would have paged you for those 4 startup crashes
labels.Bottleneck: the only signal is a success email, so a pre-email crash equals silence
labels.Checked myself: per your brief, expired token crashed before the email step 4 nights with no other alert

note: The reply recommends a single alert, but it runs as a self-hosted Docker container on the Synology, so it counts as LARGER even though the Deleted line drops Docker.
